Messages.Author: Jon Cooper
Messages.Body:
Which effect happens first after strike: Combat ends?

Psyche or Telepathic tracking or is it entirely based on acting minion
first?

Example:
Minion A is blocked by minion B.
Minion A majestys.
Minion B Psyches, but minion a wants to telepathic track.

Which happens first and would the effect be the same if B was the acting
minion?

Hope thats clear....

Actually, TT and Psyche! have slightly different timings:

Psyche:
'...at the end of combat' (has been clarified to mean 'right after combat ends')

TT:
When 'combat is about to end' (so, before combat actually ends)

TT will always go before Psyche!

Flux
